units: <cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 1:7">M. Kat. I, 7</cite> <he>מפני שנ׳ הוא לה</he> because it defaces her (for the time being); Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39ᵇ bot. <cite ref="N00608"><he>נִיבּוּל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 7:3">Snh. VII, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Sanhedrin 52b:8">52ᵇ</cite>) <he>נ׳ הוא זה</he> this (the Roman way of decapitation with the sword) is a repulsive disfigurement.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 3:8:5">Y. Sot. III, end, 19ᵇ</cite> <he>אבל אשה על ידי שנִיוּוּלָהּ מרובה וכ׳</he> but a woman, because her disgrace (feeling of shame) is greater, must not be executed naked. Ib. 18ᵈ bot. <he>המקום … תחת ניוולה</he> the Lord will indemnify her for her (unmerited) exposure.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 943:2">Yalk. Prov. 943</cite> <he>חיים של נִוּוּל</he> a hideous life (without enjoyment).

<cite ref="Nedarim 80a:3">Ned. 80ᵃ</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>נ׳ דחד יומא לא שמיה נ׳</he> a neglected appearance for one day (by not bathing) is not considered self-neglect in the sense of the law; a. fr.
